definition: adds a fact or idea that seems surprising or very different from what you have just said
exampleSentence: The hotel was expensive. However, the service was excellent.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn đắt. Tuy nhiên, dịch vụ rất tuyệt.

definition: in spite of a fact you have just mentioned; formal
exampleSentence: The plan was risky. Nevertheless, we decided to go ahead.
exampleTranslation: Kế hoạch có nhiều rủi ro. Dù vậy, chúng tôi vẫn quyết định thực hiện.

definition: in spite of a fact you have just mentioned; formal
exampleSentence: The results were small. Nonetheless, they were important.
exampleTranslation: Kết quả khá nhỏ. Dù vậy, chúng rất quan trọng.

definition: introduces a fact or quality that is surprising after what you have just said
exampleSentence: He is very rich, yet he never spends money.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy rất giàu, vậy mà chẳng bao giờ tiêu tiền.

definition: in spite of what has just been said or done
exampleSentence: I know it's cold, but I still want to go swimming.
exampleTranslation: Tôi biết trời lạnh, nhưng tôi vẫn muốn đi bơi.

definition: added at the end of a sentence to give a fact or opinion that is surprising after what you have just said; spoken
exampleSentence: It was a long trip. I enjoyed it, though.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến đi dài. Nhưng tôi vẫn thích.

definition: introduces a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely
exampleSentence: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
exampleTranslation: Mặc dù trời mưa, chúng tôi vẫn đi dạo.

definition: used to say that although something is true of one thing, it is not true of another; formal
exampleSentence: Tom loves cities, whereas his wife prefers the countryside.
exampleTranslation: Tom thích thành phố, trong khi vợ anh ấy thích nông thôn hơn.

definition: used to say what is done when you have just said that a particular thing is not done
exampleSentence: I didn't go to the gym. Instead, I stayed home and read.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không đến phòng tập. Thay vào đó, tôi ở nhà đọc sách.

definition: used when one situation is the opposite of another
exampleSentence: Some people work best in silence. Conversely, others need background noise.
exampleTranslation: Một số người làm việc tốt nhất khi yên tĩnh. Ngược lại, người khác cần tiếng ồn xung quanh.

definition: used to say what bad thing will happen if something is not done
exampleSentence: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
exampleTranslation: Nhanh lên, kẻo chúng ta lỡ tàu.

definition: used to add a statement that says almost the opposite of what you have just said; spoken
translation: mà nghĩ lại thì, nhưng mặt khác
exampleSentence: It's a good price. Then again, we don't really need it.
exampleTranslation: Giá tốt đấy. Mà nghĩ lại thì mình cũng không thật sự cần nó.

definition: used when you admit that something is true
exampleSentence: Admittedly, the food was cold, but the staff were kind.
exampleTranslation: Phải thừa nhận là đồ ăn nguội, nhưng nhân viên rất tử tế.

definition: used when you admit that something is true
translation: đành công nhận là, thừa nhận là
exampleSentence: Granted, the job is hard, but the pay is good.
exampleTranslation: Đành công nhận là công việc khó, nhưng lương tốt.

definition: used when you say something that is almost the opposite of what you have just said, or that explains it; British English
translation: nhưng phải nói, mà cũng phải nói là
exampleSentence: I enjoyed the trip. Mind you, it was very tiring.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích chuyến đi. Nhưng phải nói là nó rất mệt.

definition: in spite of what has happened
translation: dù vậy, ngay cả khi đó
exampleSentence: I explained it twice. Even then, he didn't understand.
exampleTranslation: Tôi giải thích hai lần. Dù vậy, anh ấy vẫn không hiểu.

definition: without being affected or influenced by something
exampleSentence: They went ahead with the party regardless.
exampleTranslation: Họ vẫn tổ chức bữa tiệc, bất kể thế nào.

definition: in spite of what you have just mentioned; also used to return to the main subject
translation: dù sao thì, dù gì đi nữa
exampleSentence: It might rain, but we'll go anyway.
exampleTranslation: Trời có thể mưa, nhưng dù sao chúng ta vẫn đi.

definition: used to say that something will be the same whichever of two things happens or is true
exampleSentence: We can go by bus or by train. Either way, it takes two hours.
exampleTranslation: Mình có thể đi xe buýt hoặc tàu. Dù đi cách nào cũng mất hai tiếng.

definition: used when you want to say that something else is also true
exampleSentence: The job is stressful. At the same time, it is very rewarding.
exampleTranslation: Công việc căng thẳng. Mặt khác, nó mang lại nhiều thành quả.

definition: used to show that a new point is like the one before it
translation: tương tự, tương tự như vậy
exampleSentence: Cats need regular exercise. Similarly, dogs need daily walks.
exampleTranslation: Mèo cần vận động thường xuyên. Tương tự, chó cần được đi dạo hằng ngày.

definition: used when you introduce a second idea that is as important as the first
translation: cũng quan trọng không kém là
exampleSentence: Cost matters. Equally, we must think about quality.
exampleTranslation: Chi phí là điều quan trọng. Cũng quan trọng không kém, chúng ta phải nghĩ đến chất lượng.

definition: for the same reasons; used to say that something else is also true; formal
translation: cũng với lý do đó, tương tự như vậy
exampleSentence: Praise can motivate people. By the same token, harsh criticism can discourage them.
exampleTranslation: Lời khen có thể thúc đẩy mọi người. Cũng với lý do đó, lời chê gay gắt có thể làm họ nản lòng.

definition: used to compare two things and show that they are different
exampleSentence: I prefer tea, as opposed to coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích trà hơn, khác với cà phê.

definition: used to emphasize that something is true although something else is also true
exampleSentence: He kept working even though he was ill.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy vẫn làm việc mặc dù đang bệnh.

definition: used to say that something will definitely happen or be true whatever else happens
translation: dù thế nào, trong mọi trường hợp
exampleSentence: I may be late, but I'll be there in any event.
exampleTranslation: Có thể tôi sẽ đến muộn, nhưng dù thế nào tôi cũng sẽ có mặt.

definition: adds information that supports what you have just said; very formal
exampleSentence: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is quick.
exampleTranslation: Kế hoạch này rẻ. Hơn nữa, nó còn nhanh.

definition: adds to what has already been said; formal
exampleSentence: The flat is small. Furthermore, it is far from the center.
exampleTranslation: Căn hộ nhỏ. Hơn nữa, nó còn xa trung tâm.

definition: used when you add another reason; spoken
exampleSentence: I can't go. Besides, I haven't been invited.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không đi được. Vả lại, tôi cũng chưa được mời.

definition: adds more information that emphasizes what you are saying
exampleSentence: She is smart, and what's more, she works hard.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thông minh, hơn nữa còn chăm chỉ.

definition: used to add more information; informal
exampleSentence: The apartment is big, plus it has a balcony.
exampleTranslation: Căn hộ rộng, thêm vào đó còn có ban công.

definition: used after a negative statement to say that the next thing is even more unlikely
exampleSentence: I can't cook an egg, let alone a whole dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi còn không chiên nổi quả trứng, huống chi nấu cả bữa tối.

definition: shows a result of something you have just mentioned; formal
exampleSentence: The road is closed. Therefore, we must take another route.
exampleTranslation: Đường bị đóng. Do đó, chúng ta phải đi đường khác.

definition: shows a result of something you have just mentioned; formal
exampleSentence: Sales fell sharply, and thus the company lost money.
exampleTranslation: Doanh số giảm mạnh, và vì vậy công ty bị lỗ.

definition: for this reason; formal
exampleSentence: The roads were icy, hence the delay.
exampleTranslation: Đường đóng băng, vì thế mới bị chậm trễ.

definition: as a result
exampleSentence: He missed the deadline. Consequently, he lost the contract.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy trễ hạn nộp. Do đó, anh ấy mất hợp đồng.

definition: used to say that someone does something because of the reason you have just stated
exampleSentence: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt nên đi ngủ sớm.

definition: as a result of something; formal
exampleSentence: He didn't study. As a consequence, he failed the exam.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy không học bài. Hậu quả là anh ấy thi trượt.

definition: used to say that something happens or is true as a result of the situation you have just stated, or to give a purpose
exampleSentence: I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget.
exampleTranslation: Tôi viết nó ra để không quên.

definition: if that is the situation
translation: nếu vậy thì, trong trường hợp đó
exampleSentence: "The shop is closed." "In that case, let's go tomorrow."
exampleTranslation: "Cửa hàng đóng cửa rồi." "Nếu vậy thì mai mình đi."

definition: used to say that if your first suggestion does not work or is not possible, there is another possibility
translation: nếu không được thì, nếu không
exampleSentence: Try calling her. Failing that, send an email.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thử gọi cho cô ấy. Nếu không được thì gửi email.

definition: used to say that something bad will happen if someone does not do something; spoken
exampleSentence: Be quiet, or else I'll tell your mother.
exampleTranslation: Im lặng đi, nếu không tôi sẽ nói với mẹ con.

definition: therefore; formal
exampleSentence: I think, ergo I am.
exampleTranslation: Tôi suy nghĩ, do đó tôi tồn tại.

definition: used before you say the first of several things you want to say
exampleSentence: First, wash your hands. Then dry them well.
exampleTranslation: Đầu tiên, hãy rửa tay. Sau đó lau khô tay thật kỹ.

definition: used to say that the fact or reason you are about to mention is the first one and others will follow
exampleSentence: Firstly, I'd like to thank everyone for coming.
exampleTranslation: Trước hết, tôi xin cảm ơn mọi người đã đến.

definition: used before you add a second piece of information to what you have already said
exampleSentence: First, it is too expensive. Second, it is too far.
exampleTranslation: Thứ nhất, nó quá đắt. Thứ hai, nó quá xa.

definition: used when you give a second point or a second reason for something
exampleSentence: Firstly, it's cheap. Secondly, it's close to home.
exampleTranslation: Thứ nhất, nó rẻ. Thứ hai, nó gần nhà.

definition: immediately afterwards
exampleSentence: Mix the flour and eggs. Next, add the milk.
exampleTranslation: Trộn bột và trứng. Tiếp theo, thêm sữa.

definition: used to say what happens next or what you do next
exampleSentence: We had dinner and then we went for a walk.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn tối rồi đi dạo.

definition: after an event or time that has already been mentioned
exampleSentence: We watched the film and had coffee afterwards.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xem phim rồi sau đó uống cà phê.
